dialogue.speech: It's our chance to find out who the boss really is.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'll find him, no matter what.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Could you give me that charm to wish me good luck on this final mission?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Ladybugs are considered sun bugs.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: They're symbols of life, right?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: They're good luck charms, right?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Yes. Ladybugs bring good luck.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I wonder... if I'll be able to like my father.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: No family worries about that.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We're almost to the top.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Wh-What?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: No... It can't be!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Could the boss...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: In order to make sure he stays completely invisible...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Did he have us protect his daughter

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: in order to ensure that he could finish off his daughter himself?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: A father did this to his innocent daughter,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: all to cover his own a*s?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This is unforgivable!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You have once again betrayed my heart!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Boss, I was just going to seek out your true identity,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but the plan's changed.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm going to get rid of you right now!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: What about Trish?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: My daughter has nothing to do with you.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You could never understand my true feelings!

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Something is wrong!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Zipper Man!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The one who was in the pillar's shadow...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: was me!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I decided to show you... as a parting gift.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I erased time and leapt past it.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I don't care who it is.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I will not allow anyone to threaten my throne, no matter what.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, your mission to act as Trish's bodyguard

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: has now come to an end.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: After meeting Giorno, Bucciarati decided to make a wager on his golden dream.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: Their path is likely to be filled with even more hardships.
